words.def: a person who watches television or a video
words.ex: The cooking program is popular with young ___s.

words.def: at a time after the present or after the time you are talking about
words.ex: I'm busy now. Let's talk about it ___.

words.def: a story that is acted out by actors on a stage
words.ex: It was the day of the school ___.

words.def: to accidentally make liquid fall out of a container
words.ex: Be careful not to ___ the milk on the table.

words.def: something that shows what other things of the same kind are like
words.ex: It's a great ___ of public art.

words.def: appealing and easy to remember
words.ex: The song has a very ___ melody.

words.def: to decide that something (such as a game, performance, etc.) will not happen
words.ex: The baseball game was ___ed because of rain.

words.def: to make something ready for use or for an event
words.ex: Let's ___ a surprise party for Jiho after school.

words.def: to make (something) known
words.ex: "Spill the beans" means to ___ a secret.

words.def: a song or melody that keeps repeating in one's mind
words.ex: That song is a real ___. I can't stop humming it.

words.def: a feeling of surprise and admiration caused by something beautiful or unusual
words.ex: The children looked at the fireworks in ___.

words.def: something that achieves positive results
words.ex: Tommy kept his promise, and the surprise party was a big ___.

words.def: to finish making or doing (something)
words.ex: When the voting was ___d, the beans were spilled.

words.def: used to say what is really true
words.ex: "Break a leg!" may sound like a bad thing, but it ___ means "Good luck!"

words.def: in a kind and respectful way
words.ex: It means to refuse an offer ___ but wish to do it later.

words.def: to make an official choice for a person or idea, for example by raising your hand or putting a paper in a box
words.ex: When Greeks ___d, they put a white or black bean in a big jar.

words.def: the act of saying that you will give something or do something for someone
words.ex: The player got an ___ to join the soccer team.

words.def: unhappy because something you hoped for did not happen
words.ex: Although Sarah was a little ___, she understood Emily's situation.

words.def: to stop existing; to leave a place
words.ex: By wishing each other bad luck, they believed that it would ___.

words.def: open to or shared by all the people in an area
words.ex: It's art in ___ places like parks and streets.

words.def: a word or group of words that has a particular meaning
words.ex: This ___ is still used today.

words.def: belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence
words.ex: It comes from an ___ Greek way of voting.

words.def: to want something to happen or be true
words.ex: People say "Break a leg" to ___ performers good luck.

words.def: gradually, as time passes
words.ex: ___, the child became more confident.

words.def: to separate into pieces suddenly, often because of falling or being hit
words.ex: Be careful! Don't ___ the glass.

words.def: a small group of words that has a special meaning
words.ex: German actors first used this ___.

words.def: to say that you will not accept or do something
words.ex: She ___d the invitation because she was busy.

words.def: a group of words whose meaning is different from the meanings of the single words
words.ex: "Spill the beans" is an ___ that means "reveal a secret."

words.def: the newest or most recent
words.ex: A smart farm uses the ___ technology to grow vegetables.

words.def: a seed of some plants that people cook and eat
words.ex: Greeks put a white or black ___ in a big jar.

words.def: to feel happy and excited about something that is going to happen
words.ex: I ___ seeing you this weekend.

words.def: to compete with others to see who is the fastest
words.ex: Canoe teams have to ___ through the icy river.

words.def: to put (something) in a particular position
words.ex: Then ___ a stick on the syrup and quickly roll it up.

words.def: an act of entertaining people by singing, dancing, playing music, or acting
words.ex: You can also enjoy exciting concerts and ___s.

words.def: to make something flow from a container
words.ex: ___ hot maple syrup on the snow.

words.def: long and not wide, small from one side to the other side
words.ex: A toboggan is a long, ___ sled.

words.def: to fail to use something, such as an opportunity
words.ex: This race is one of the best parts of the carnival, and you shouldn't ___ it.

words.def: to be involved with others in doing something
words.ex: You can also ___ in a stamp tour.

words.def: to organize or arrange an event, meeting, or activity for people to attend
words.ex: Our school will ___ a music festival next month.

words.def: extremely good, exciting, or pleasing
words.ex: Look around at my ___ ice garden.

words.def: a special food that is nice to eat, like candy or a dessert
words.ex: There are many delicious ___s to eat at the carnival.

words.def: to take a fruit or flower from the plant where it grows
words.ex: I ___ed these strawberries myself.

words.def: following the length of a road, river, wall, etc.
words.ex: You can walk ___ the wall and enjoy the beautiful view.

words.def: to succeed in doing something or in reaching a place
words.ex: I hope they can ___ to the finish line.

words.def: a liquid that you can drink; beverage
words.ex: Hot chocolate is always the perfect ___ in cold weather.

words.def: a piece of art made by shaping stone, wood, ice, etc.
words.ex: You can see amazing ice ___s of trees, flowers, and animals here.

words.def: to move smoothly along a surface like ice or snow
words.ex: The children love to ___ down the snowy hill.

words.def: the two people or things together
words.ex: She invited ___ her teacher and her friend.

words.def: a vehicle that slides over snow, used for fun or travel
words.ex: The kids rode a ___ down the snowy hill.

words.def: a person, animal, or object used as the symbol of a team or event
words.ex: I am Bonhomme, the ___ of the carnival.

words.def: to try a small amount of food to see what it is like
words.ex: You also have to ___ maple taffy.

words.def: difficult or impossible to move from a position
words.ex: Look! One team is ___ in the ice and can't move!

words.def: to cook food, especially meat, in an oven or over a fire
words.ex: We ___ed marshmallows over the campfire.

words.def: a large, strong building with high walls, where kings and queens lived in the past
words.ex: You can see a huge famous ___ on your left.

words.def: covered with or consisting of ice
words.ex: On your right, you can see a beautiful ___ river.

words.def: so special or strong that you will always remember it
words.ex: Do you want to take home an ___ memory from the carnival?

words.def: to consist of; to have something as its parts
words.ex: Teams ___ five members.

words.def: from one side or end of something to the other
words.ex: Canoe teams have to race ___ the icy river for about three kilometers.

words.def: a public festival with music, dancing, and games, often held in the streets
words.ex: Welcome to the Quebec Winter ___!

words.def: to turn something over and over or form it into a round shape
words.ex: Then place a stick on the syrup and quickly ___ it up.

목적격 관계대명사.s: He met a woman (______) works at the hospital.
목적격 관계대명사.x: 뒤에 바로 동사(works) → 주어가 빠진 주격 관계대명사 who (목적격 whom ×)

목적격 관계대명사.s: I like the singer and the song (______) you recommended yesterday.
목적격 관계대명사.x: 선행사가 사람 + 사물(the singer and the song) → that

목적격 관계대명사.s: <보기> The movie <u>which</u> I watched last night was exciting.
목적격 관계대명사.q: 밑줄 친 which와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
o: This is the bike <u>which</u> has a basket.
I like the song <u>which</u> you recommended.
The dog <u>which</u> is barking is mine.
Do you know <u>which</u> bus goes to the station?
목적격 관계대명사.x: <보기>·② 뒤에 주어 + 동사(I watched / you recommended) → 목적격 / ①④ 주격 ③⑤ 의문사

o: The teacher whom I respect is very kind.
She likes the bike which her father bought for her.
He is the actor whom many teens like him.
Here's the book that I told you about.
The cookies Sam baked were very delicious.
목적격 관계대명사.x: 관계대명사가 목적어 역할 → 뒤의 목적어 him을 지워야 해요 (like him ×)

목적격 관계대명사.s: My neighbors (______) I've known for 5 years are kind.
목적격 관계대명사.x: 선행사 My neighbors(사람) + 목적어 자리 → whom (주어가 길어진 문장 — 동사는 are)

목적격 관계대명사.s: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 생략할 수 있는 것은?
o: The boy <u>who</u> is running is my brother.
This is the cake <u>that</u> my mom baked.
I have a friend <u>who</u> lives in Busan.
Look at the girl and the dog <u>that</u> are playing.
The book <u>which</u> is on the desk is mine.
목적격 관계대명사.x: 생략할 수 있는 건 목적격만 → ② (뒤에 my mom baked) / 나머지는 뒤에 동사 → 주격(생략 ×)

목적격 관계대명사.s: The watch was expensive. We saw it yesterday.
목적격 관계대명사.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
o: The watch we saw it yesterday was expensive.
The watch which we saw yesterday was expensive.
The watch who we saw yesterday was expensive.
The watch which saw yesterday was expensive.
The watch was expensive which we saw it yesterday.
목적격 관계대명사.x: 사물 → which · 목적어 it은 지움 · 관계대명사절은 선행사 바로 뒤

목적격 관계대명사.s: 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
o: This is the painting ___ my friend painted.
Check the items ___ you need for fishing.
I found the keys ___ you left on the table.
Do you know the girl ___ I'm talking about?
Where are the socks ___ my mom gave me?
목적격 관계대명사.x: ④ 선행사가 사람(the girl) → whom(who) / 나머지는 사물 → which

접속사 although.s: (______) I was sick, I still went to school.
비록 그는 키가 크지 않지만, 농구를 잘한다.
o: Although he is not tall, he plays basketball well.
Because he is not tall, he plays basketball well.
Although he is tall, he plays basketball well.
He is not tall, although plays basketball well.
___ it was raining, we played soccer.
___ he studied very hard, he passed the test.
___ she was busy, she helped me.
___ I like music, I can't sing well.
___ the weather was cold, they played outside.

접속사 although.s: Although "Break a leg!" may sound like a bad thing, it actually means "Good luck!"
접속사 although.q: Although와 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은?

접속사 although.s: He studied hard. He failed the test.
접속사 although.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것은?
o: Because he studied hard, he failed the test.
Although he studied hard, he failed the test.
He studied hard although he failed the test.
So he studied hard, he failed the test.
접속사 although.x: 열심히 했는데 떨어짐 → Although + 앞의 일 / ③은 '떨어졌지만 열심히 했다' — 뜻이 바뀜

o: Although it was cold, but we went out.
Although the rain, we played outside.
We enjoyed the movie although it was very long.
Although of the noise, I slept well.
Although tired, but he kept working.
접속사 although.x: ③ although 뒤 주어+동사 ✔ / ①⑤ although와 but을 같이 못 씀 ②④ although 뒤에 명사만 ×

o: I stayed home although it was raining heavily.
He couldn't sleep although he drank too much coffee.
Although Sarah was disappointed, she understood Emily's situation.
Although I know the answer, I will tell you.
She can't join us although she has another meeting.
접속사 although.x: ③ 실망했지만 이해했다(반대 ✔) / ①②⑤는 원인-결과라 because, ④는 '알지만 말하지 않겠다'여야 자연스러움

의문사 + to부정사.s:
나는 점심으로 무엇을 먹을지 결정할 수 없다.
I can't decide ______ for lunch.
I can teach you ______ like me.

I don't know where I should put this flowerpot.
= I don't know ______ this flowerpot.

나는 누구에게 도움을 청해야 할지 잘 모르겠다.
I'm not sure ______ for help.

o: She didn't know why to ask questions.
What to wear depends on the weather.
Let's talk about where to stay.
의문사 + to부정사.x: why + to부정사는 쓸 수 없어요 → why she should ask

의문사 + to부정사.s: 밑줄 친 부분이 문장의 주어로 쓰인 것은?
o: Please tell me <u>where to take</u> the bus.
의문사 + to부정사.x: ① 동사 is 앞 → 주어 / ② 보어 ③④⑤ 목적어 — 의문사+to부정사는 명사 역할

의문사 + to부정사.s: Matt asked when he should take the cookies out of the oven.
o: Matt asked when to take the cookies out of the oven.
Matt asked when taking the cookies out of the oven.
Matt asked to take when the cookies out of the oven.
Matt asked when should take the cookies out of the oven.
의문사 + to부정사.x: when he should take = when to take

so ~ that.s:
그 상자는 너무 무거워서 그는 그것을 들 수 없었다.
The box was ______ he couldn't lift it.

날씨가 너무 추워서 그녀는 밖에 나갈 수 없었다.
The weather was so cold that she ______ out.
so ~ that.x: 결과(나갈 수 없었다) · 주절이 과거 → that절도 과거 couldn't go

so ~ that.s: The problem was so difficult that I couldn't solve it.
o: The problem was too difficult for me to solve.
The problem was difficult enough to solve.
The problem was so difficult to solve it.
The problem was too difficult that I solve it.

so ~ that.s: The speech was so boring that some people ______ early.

o: It is so fast that you will feel like you are on a roller coaster.
The race is so exciting that you will forget about the cold.
She was so kind that everyone liked her.
He ran so fast that nobody couldn't catch him.
The weather was so hot that the game was canceled.
so ~ that.x: nobody 자체가 부정 → nobody could catch him (이중 부정 ×)

so ~ that.s: <보기> I spoke slowly <u>so that</u> everybody could understand.
so ~ that.q: 밑줄 친 so that과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
o: It was so cold that we stayed home.
She saved money <u>so that</u> she could buy a bike.
He was so tired that he fell asleep.
The line was so long that we waited.
The book was so interesting that I read it twice.
so ~ that.x: 붙여 쓴 so that = '~하기 위해서'(목적) → ② / 나머지는 so 형용사 that(결과)

sentences.ko: 커튼이 막 올라가려는 참에, 그녀는 매우 긴장했다.
sentences.html: The curtains <u>①</u> go up, and she felt very <u>②</u>.
sentences.full: The curtains were about to go up, and she felt very nervous.
sentences.tip: be about to + 동사원형 = 막 ~하려 하다 · feel + 형용사

sentences.ko: 비록 '다리 부러져라!'가 나쁜 것처럼 들리겠지만, 그것은 사실 '행운을 빌어!'를 의미한다.
sentences.html: <u>①</u> "Break a leg!" may <u>②</u> a bad thing, it <u>③</u> means "Good luck!"
sentences.full: Although "Break a leg!" may sound like a bad thing, it actually means "Good luck!"
sentences.tip: Although(양보) · sound like + 명사 · 동사 means를 꾸미는 부사 actually

sentences.ko: 20세기 초에 미국에 온 독일 배우들이 이 어구를 처음 사용했다.
sentences.html: German actors <u>①</u> to the United States in the early 20th century first used this <u>②</u>.
sentences.full: German actors who came to the United States in the early 20th century first used this phrase.
sentences.tip: 사람 + 뒤에 동사 → 주격 who · 과거 came

sentences.ko: 서로에게 불운을 빎으로써, 그들은 불운이 없어질 거라고 믿었다.
sentences.html: <u>①</u> each other bad luck, they believed that it would <u>②</u>.
sentences.full: By wishing each other bad luck, they believed that it would go away.
sentences.tip: by + -ing = ~함으로써 · would + 동사원형

sentences.ko: '다리 부러져라'는 사람들이 공연 전에 공연자들에게 행운을 빌기 위해 말하는 어구이다.
sentences.html: "Break a leg" is a phrase <u>①</u> to <u>②</u> performers good luck before a show.
sentences.full: "Break a leg" is a phrase which people say to wish performers good luck before a show.
sentences.tip: 사물 + 목적격 which (say의 목적어 it은 지움) · to부정사(목적)

sentences.ko: 그러나 Tommy는 비밀을 지키는 것을 잘하지 못했다.
sentences.html: But Tommy was not <u>①</u> <u>②</u> secrets.
sentences.full: But Tommy was not good at keeping secrets.
sentences.tip: be good at + 동명사(-ing) = ~을 잘하다

sentences.ko: 그것은 고대 그리스의 투표 방법에서 유래한 것이다.
sentences.html: It <u>①</u> an <u>②</u> Greek way of <u>③</u>.
sentences.full: It comes from an ancient Greek way of voting.
sentences.tip: come from = ~에서 유래하다 · 전치사 of + 동명사

sentences.ko: 투표가 완료되었을 때, 그 콩들은 결과를 드러내기 위해 쏟아졌다.
sentences.html: When the voting <u>①</u>, the beans <u>②</u> to <u>③</u> the results.
sentences.full: When the voting was completed, the beans were spilled to reveal the results.
sentences.tip: 투표가 완료'되고' 콩이 쏟아'지는' → 수동태(be + p.p.) · to + 동사원형

sentences.ko: 비록 Sarah는 조금 실망했지만, 그녀는 Emily의 상황을 이해했다.
sentences.html: <u>①</u> Sarah was a little <u>②</u>, she understood Emily's <u>③</u>.
sentences.full: Although Sarah was a little disappointed, she understood Emily's situation.
sentences.tip: 실망을 '느끼는' 사람 → disappointed · 반대 내용 → Although

sentences.ko: 그것은 제안을 정중하게 거절하지만 나중에 하고 싶어 한다는 것을 의미한다.
sentences.html: It means <u>①</u> an offer <u>②</u> but wish to do it <u>③</u>.
sentences.full: It means to refuse an offer politely but wish to do it later.
sentences.tip: 동사 refuse를 꾸미는 부사 politely · later = 나중에 (lately = 최근에)

sentences.ko: 우천 교환권은 비 때문에 야구 경기가 취소되었을 때 사람들이 미래의 경기를 위해 받는 표였다.
sentences.html: A rain check was a ticket <u>①</u> for a future game when a baseball game <u>②</u> because of rain.
o: that people received it – was canceled
sentences.full: A rain check was a ticket that people received for a future game when a baseball game was canceled because of rain.
sentences.tip: 사물 + 목적격 that (it 지움) · 경기가 취소'되다' → 수동태

sentences.ko: 시간이 흐르면서, '우천 교환권을 받다'는 지금은 할 수 없지만 나중에 하고 싶다고 말하기 위해 널리 사용되어 왔다.
sentences.html: <u>①</u>, "take a rain check" has been widely <u>②</u> to say that you can't do something now and want to do it later.
sentences.full: Over time, "take a rain check" has been widely used to say that you can't do something now and want to do it later.
sentences.tip: over time = 시간이 지나면서 (on time = 제시간에) · has been + p.p. (수동)

sentences.ko: 저를 따라오세요, 그러면 이곳에서 무엇을 해야 할지 보여 줄게요.
sentences.html: Follow me, <u>①</u> I'll show you <u>②</u> here.
sentences.full: Follow me, and I'll show you what to do here.
sentences.tip: 명령문, and ~ = …해라, 그러면 ~ · what to do = 무엇을 해야 할지

sentences.ko: 퀘벡 윈터 카니발은 캐나다 퀘벡에서 보통 1월과 2월 사이에 10일 동안 열려요.
sentences.html: The Quebec Winter Carnival <u>①</u> for 10 days <u>②</u> January and February in Quebec, Canada.
sentences.full: The Quebec Winter Carnival is usually held for 10 days between January and February in Quebec, Canada.
sentences.tip: 카니발이 '열리다' → 수동태 is held (빈도부사는 be동사 뒤) · between A and B

sentences.ko: 궁전이 얼음과 눈으로 만들어지기 때문에, 그것은 낮 동안 아름답게 빛나요.
sentences.html: Because the palace <u>①</u> ice and snow, it shines <u>②</u> during the day.
sentences.full: Because the palace is made of ice and snow, it shines beautifully during the day.
sentences.tip: be made of = ~로 만들어지다 · 동사 shines를 꾸미는 부사

sentences.ko: 제가 어떻게 나처럼 춤추는지 당신에게 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요.
sentences.html: I can teach <u>①</u> <u>②</u> like me.
sentences.full: I can teach you how to dance like me.
sentences.tip: teach + 간접목적어 + 직접목적어(how to dance)

sentences.ko: 그것은 너무 빨라서 마치 롤러코스터에 탄 것처럼 느낄 거예요.
sentences.html: It is <u>①</u> you will feel <u>②</u> you are on a roller coaster.
sentences.full: It is so fast that you will feel like you are on a roller coaster.
sentences.tip: so + 형용사 + that (결과) · feel like + 주어 + 동사 = ~인 것처럼 느끼다

sentences.ko: 팀들은 보통 다섯 팀원으로 구성되고, 남성과 여성 모두 팀에 들어갈 수 있어요.
sentences.html: Teams <u>①</u> five members, and <u>②</u> men <u>③</u> women can join the team.
o: are usually made up of – both – and
usually make up of – both – or
are usually made up – both – and
are usually made up of – either – and
sentences.full: Teams are usually made up of five members, and both men and women can join the team.
sentences.tip: be made up of = ~로 구성되다 · both A and B (either A or B)

sentences.ko: 경주는 너무 흥미진진해서 당신은 추위에 대해 잊게 될 거예요.
sentences.html: The race is <u>①</u> you will <u>②</u> about the cold.
sentences.full: The race is so exciting that you will forget about the cold.
sentences.tip: 경주가 흥미를 '주는' 쪽 → exciting · will + 동사원형

sentences.ko: 그런 다음 그 시럽 위에 막대를 놓고 빨리 돌돌 말아요.
sentences.html: Then <u>①</u> a stick on the syrup and quickly <u>②</u>.
sentences.full: Then place a stick on the syrup and quickly roll it up.
sentences.tip: 명령문은 동사원형 · 대명사 it은 roll과 up 사이에 (roll up it ×)

sentences.ko: 오, 더 많은 정보는 우리 웹사이트를 확인하는 것 잊지 마세요.
sentences.html: Oh, don't <u>①</u> <u>②</u> our website for more information.
sentences.full: Oh, don't forget to check our website for more information.
sentences.tip: forget to ~ = (앞으로) ~할 것을 잊다 · don't + 동사원형

dialogs.who: L7 Topic 1-A · 더 말해 달라고 하기
dialogs.ko: 그것에 대해 더 말해 줄 수 있니?
dialogs.en: Can you tell me more about it?

dialogs.ko: 스마트 농장은 채소를 기르기 위해 최신 기술을 사용해.
dialogs.en: A smart farm uses the latest technology to grow vegetables.

dialogs.ko: 최초의 지퍼가 신발에 사용되었다는 걸 알았니?
dialogs.en: Did you know that the first zipper was used on a shoe?

dialogs.ko: 그것은 공원이나 거리 같은 공공장소에 있는 미술이야.
dialogs.en: It's art in public places like parks and streets.

dialogs.ko: 너는 얼음낚시를 해 본 적 있니?
dialogs.en: Have you ever tried ice fishing?

dialogs.ko: 나는 얼음이 언 강에서 낚시하는 것을 기대하고 있어.
dialogs.en: I'm looking forward to fishing on the icy river.

dialogs.ko: 나는 지난주에 한 농장에서 딸기 따기 행사에 참여했어.
dialogs.en: I participated in a strawberry picking event at a farm last week.

dialogs.ko: 너는 성곽을 따라 걷고 아름다운 경치를 즐길 수 있어.
dialogs.en: You can walk along the wall and enjoy the beautiful view.

dialogs.ko: 나는 Emily와 함께 도시를 둘러보는 것을 정말 기대하고 있어.
dialogs.en: I'm really looking forward to exploring around the city with Emily.

lines: Look! There's a smart farm in this subway station.
I said, "There's a smart farm here."
A smart farm? Can you tell me more about it?
A smart farm uses the latest technology to grow vegetables.
x: That's too bad. I don't like vegetables.

lines: Did you know that the first zipper was used on a shoe?
I said, "The first zipper was used on a shoe."
That's interesting. Can you tell me more about it?
Sure. A man wanted to put on his shoes quickly, so he made zippers for them.
x: Sure. I made zippers for my jacket.

lines: Wow! Look at the big sculpture over there.
It's beautiful. The word "love" is in Korean letters.
It's a great example of public art.
I said "public art." It's art for everyone.
x: No, I didn't. I don't like art.

lines: Have you ever tried ice fishing?
Yes, I have, Alex. I went to an ice festival last winter and tried ice fishing there.
That's great! My family is planning to go ice fishing this winter.
Oh, you're going to love it. It's really exciting.
Yeah. I'm looking forward to fishing on the icy river.
x: No, I haven't. I've never been to a festival.

lines: My friend Emily is visiting Seoul this weekend. Where can I take her?
Well, Lucy, have you ever visited Hanyangdoseong before?
It's an old wall surrounding Seoul.
That sounds interesting. What can we do there?
You can walk along the wall and enjoy the beautiful view.
x: Yes, I have. It's a new building in Busan.
